faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science (HITS) for a project-based research position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised in HITS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under the BIRAC-SEBRI Funded Project.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc in Chemistry, Physics, or Material Science, or an M.Tech in Nanotechnology or Biotechnology with a minimum of 60% marks.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply for HITS JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 21 and 35 years of age. Age relaxations are provided for SC, ST, and OBC candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered to the selected Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 31,000 plus 16% HRA per month for the initial two years, which increases to Rs. 35,000 plus 16% HRA per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to send the completed application form via email is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email to the designated institutional email addresses provided in the official recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for HITS JRF posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on predefined eligibility criteria followed by a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF and application details?
faq.answer: You can check the official notification PDF and find complete application guidelines through the Important Links section provided in this article.
